🔄 Content updated (published: November 16, 2026 / previously: July 8, 2026)
Key changes: Winter traffic safety campaign runs December 1–14, 2026. Coordinated action days are December 4 (Drunk Driving Elimination Day) and December 10 (Traffic Fatality Zero Target Day / Bicycle Traffic Safety Day).

Saitama Prefecture will conduct a winter traffic safety campaign from December 1 (Tuesday) through December 14 (Monday), 2026 — 14 days total.

Saitama has the 8th highest traffic fatality rate nationwide. As year-end approaches, increased movement of people and vehicles raises accident risks. Drunk driving is a particular concern as social drinking occasions increase.

Campaign priorities:
• Prevent traffic accidents involving elderly people during twilight and nighttime hours
• Eliminate drunk driving
• Promote bicycle traffic rule compliance and helmet use
• Advance speed reduction measures on residential roads

Coordinated action days:
• December 4 (Friday) — Drunk Driving Elimination Day
• December 10 (Thursday) — Traffic Fatality Zero Target Day and Bicycle Traffic Safety Day

Campaign slogan: "People, vehicles, and bicycles together — Safe and secure Saitama."

Saitama Police and municipalities will work together to run awareness activities.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/shiminseikatsubu/jinkenkurashianzen/bohan/10881.html
